turns.user_query: Show me all active farmers in Solapur district.

turns.user_query: Filter that to those who registered after Jan 1, 2023.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM farmer WHERE is_active = true AND district = 'Solapur' AND registered_on > '2023-01-01'

turns.user_query: What is the total actual yield of wheat across all plots?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(actual_yield) FROM crop_cycle WHERE crop = 'wheat'

turns.user_query: Group it by season.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT season, SUM(actual_yield) FROM crop_cycle WHERE crop = 'wheat' GROUP BY season

turns.user_query: Also include the expected yield.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT season, SUM(expected_yield) AS exp_yield, SUM(actual_yield) AS act_yield FROM crop_cycle WHERE crop = 'wheat' GROUP BY season

turns.user_query: Find the latest sensor reading for plot 5.

turns.user_query: Only show soil moisture readings.

turns.user_query: What was the weather like yesterday?
Show me all critical advisories.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM advisory WHERE severity = 'critical'

turns.user_query: Which plots do they belong to?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT p.* FROM advisory a JOIN plot p ON a.plot_id = p.id WHERE a.severity = 'critical'

turns.user_query: Who are the farmers for those plots?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT f.* FROM farmer f JOIN plot p ON f.id = p.farmer_id JOIN advisory a ON p.id = a.plot_id WHERE a.severity = 'critical'

turns.user_query: List all field agents.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM field_agent

turns.user_query: How many field visits did each of them make?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, COUNT(v.id) FROM field_agent a LEFT JOIN field_visit v ON a.id = v.agent_id GROUP BY a.id, a.name

turns.user_query: Only show agents with more than 10 visits.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, COUNT(v.id) AS visit_count FROM field_agent a LEFT JOIN field_visit v ON a.id = v.agent_id GROUP BY a.id, a.name HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 10

turns.user_query: Which of those visits were successful?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT v.* FROM field_agent a JOIN field_visit v ON a.id = v.agent_id WHERE a.id IN (SELECT a2.id FROM field_agent a2 JOIN field_visit v2 ON a2.id = v2.agent_id GROUP BY a2.id HAVING COUNT(v2.id) > 10) AND v.outcome = 'completed'

turns.user_query: I meant laterite soil actually.

turns.user_query: What are the market prices for these plots?

turns.user_query: Show only farmers in Maharashtra state.

turns.user_query: Rank the farmers in each district by their total plot area, showing the top 3 per district.
turns.gold_sql: WITH FarmerArea AS (SELECT f.id, f.name, f.district, SUM(p.area_hectares) as total_area FROM farmer f JOIN plot p ON f.id = p.farmer_id GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.district) SELECT * FROM (SELECT name, district, total_area, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY district ORDER BY total_area DESC) as rnk FROM FarmerArea) sub WHERE rnk <= 3

turns.user_query: Actually, rank them by expected yield instead of plot area.
turns.gold_sql: WITH FarmerYield AS (SELECT f.id, f.name, f.district, SUM(c.expected_yield) as total_yield FROM farmer f JOIN plot p ON f.id = p.farmer_id JOIN crop_cycle c ON p.id = c.plot_id GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.district) SELECT * FROM (SELECT name, district, total_yield, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY district ORDER BY total_yield DESC) as rnk FROM FarmerYield) sub WHERE rnk <= 3

turns.user_query: What is the average temperature reading across all plots?

Show me plots with area larger than the average plot area.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM plot WHERE area_hectares > (SELECT AVG(area_hectares) FROM plot)

turns.user_query: Classify all plots as small, medium, or large based on area. Small is under 2 hectares, medium is 2 to 5, and large is above 5.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT id, area_hectares, CASE WHEN area_hectares < 2 THEN 'small' WHEN area_hectares BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS size_category FROM plot

turns.user_query: How many plots fall into each category?
turns.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN area_hectares < 2 THEN 'small' WHEN area_hectares BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS size_category, COUNT(*) as plot_count FROM plot GROUP BY 1

turns.user_query: How many unique crops are grown across all plots?

turns.user_query: Break that down by season.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT crop) FROM crop_cycle GROUP BY season

turns.user_query: Also show the total actual yield per season.
turns.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT crop), SUM(actual_yield) FROM crop_cycle GROUP BY season

turns.user_query: Show me farmers who registered more than 2 years ago.

turns.user_query: How many of them are still active?

turns.user_query: What is their average total plot area?
